items.title: 布迪甘达基河发生大规模洪水，至少10人失踪
items.titleEn: Massive flood hits Budhi Gandaki River, at least 10 people missing
items.section: 国家政策与外交人事要闻
items.status: DeepSeek 正文分析 · 待 Codex 核验
items.statusEn: DeepSeek article analysis · pending Codex review
items.summary: 据Radio Nepal报道，戈尔卡县布迪甘达基河清晨发生大规模洪水，至少10人失踪，冲毁至少六座桥梁并损毁多所房屋，春努布里乡多个居民点受影响。助理首席县行政官内特拉·普拉萨德·夏尔马表示，被冲毁桥梁包括两座机动车桥和四座吊桥；警方称暂无人员伤亡报告，损失评估仍在进行。由于河水超过警戒水位，洪水预报处要求贝尼加特居民立即转移至高处，奇特旺和纳瓦尔帕拉西沿河居民也被提醒保持警惕。来源还称，公众可通过尼泊尔洪水信息脸书页面或拨打1155并按选项二获取洪水更新和预警。
items.summaryEn: Radio Nepal reported that a massive early-morning flood in the Budhi Gandaki River in Gorkha district left at least 10 people missing, swept away at least six bridges and destroyed several houses, affecting settlements in Chumnubri Rural Municipality. Assistant Chief District Officer Netra Prasad Sharma said the swept-away bridges included two motorable bridges and four suspension bridges; police said no casualties had been reported so far and a detailed damage assessment was still underway. With the river above the danger mark, the Flood Forecasting Division urged Benighat residents to move immediately to higher ground, and people near rivers in Chitwan and Nawalparasi were advised to stay alert. The source also said the public can get flood updates and warnings via the Nepal Flood Information Facebook page or by dialling 1155 and selecting option two.
items.analysis: 若上述情况属实，桥梁损毁可能切断戈尔卡及下游沿河社区的公路通行，并削弱依赖这些线路的通信与电力维护通道，但来源未提供任何电信或互联网中断的直接证据。洪水预报处通过脸书和1155语音渠道发布预警，表明灾害信息传播在发挥作用，但农村地区网络覆盖和电话可达性尚未验证。下一步应核实：尼泊尔电信管理局或各运营商是否报告基站退服或光纤中断，以及1155预警是否覆盖受影响乡镇。证据缺口包括伤亡最终数字、桥梁清单的权威确认、通信设施受损情况以及预警的实际触达率。
items.analysisEn: If the reported conditions hold, destroyed bridges could cut road access to Gorkha and downstream riverside communities and weaken maintenance routes for communications and power infrastructure, though the source provides no direct evidence of telecom or internet outages. The Flood Forecasting Division's use of a Facebook page and the 1155 voice channel indicates disaster messaging was active, but rural network coverage and telephone reachability remain unverified. Next verification steps: check whether the Nepal Telecommunications Authority or individual operators reported downed base stations or fibre cuts, and whether the 1155 warnings reached the affected municipalities. Evidence gaps include final casualty figures, authoritative confirmation of the bridge list, damage to communications facilities and the actual reach of the warnings.

items.title: 疑似山体滑坡引发布迪甘达基河突发洪水
items.titleEn: Landslide suspected of triggering flash floods in Budhi Gandaki River
items.section: 国家政策与外交人事要闻
items.status: DeepSeek 正文分析 · 待 Codex 核验
items.statusEn: DeepSeek article analysis · pending Codex review
items.summary: 据Radio Nepal报道，洪水预报处估计布迪甘达基河的突发洪水可能由上游山体滑坡堵塞河道引发，并称河源区及周边地区没有明显降雨可以解释此次突然洪水。水文与水资源研究中心（隶属水资源与能源委员会秘书处）发言人拉詹·巴塔拉伊表示，过去24小时该地区仅有零星降雨。当局依据初步信息和卫星图像怀疑上游滑坡阻断水流，从而触发突发洪水。
items.summaryEn: Radio Nepal reported that the Flood Forecasting Division estimated the flash floods in the Budhi Gandaki River may have been triggered by a landslide that blocked the river upstream, saying there had been no significant rainfall in the river's source area or surrounding regions to explain the sudden flooding. Rajan Bhattarai, spokesperson for the Hydrology and Water Resources Research Center under the Water and Energy Commission Secretariat, said only sporadic rainfall had occurred in the area over the past 24 hours. Based on preliminary information and satellite images, authorities suspect a landslide in the upper reaches blocked the river's flow and triggered the flash floods.
items.analysis: 若滑坡堵河这一初步判断成立，则意味着风险监测需要覆盖降雨之外的滑坡坝情景，仅靠雨量预警可能不足以保护下游居民；来源提到使用卫星图像，说明遥感在灾因判断中发挥作用，但未说明是否用于向公众发布预警。对客户（沿河居民和依赖交通、通信线路的用户）而言，潜在影响是预警时间更短、撤离窗口更紧。下一步应核实：洪水预报处是否发布正式技术通报、滑坡坝位置与稳定性评估结果，以及相关预警是否通过短信或运营商网络推送。证据缺口包括滑坡坝的确认、上游监测站点数据以及预警渠道覆盖情况。
items.analysisEn: If the preliminary landslide-dam assessment holds, risk monitoring would need to cover landslide-dam scenarios beyond rainfall, and rain-based warnings alone may not protect downstream residents; the source mentions satellite imagery, indicating remote sensing informed the cause assessment, but does not say whether it was used for public warnings. For customers, including riverside residents and users dependent on transport and communications links, the potential impact is shorter warning lead time and a narrower evacuation window. Next verification steps: check whether the Flood Forecasting Division issued a formal technical bulletin, confirm the landslide-dam location and stability assessment, and establish whether warnings were pushed via SMS or operator networks. Evidence gaps include confirmation of the landslide dam, upstream monitoring station data and warning channel coverage.

items.title: 受布迪甘达基洪水严重影响的地方政府被宣布为“灾害危机区”
items.titleEn: Local levels heavily affected by Budhi Gandaki flood declared 'disaster crisis zones'
items.status: DeepSeek 正文分析 · 待 Codex 核验
items.statusEn: DeepSeek article analysis · pending Codex review
items.summary: 据NepalKhabar报道，政府在总理瓦伦德拉·沙阿主持的会议上决定，将受布迪甘达基河洪水严重影响的地方政府宣布为灾害危机区，为期三个月，包括戈尔卡县的春努布里乡、达尔切乡和 Aarughat 乡，以及达丁县特里普拉孙达里乡第1和第2区。会议还决定将巴格隆县受洪水和滑坡严重影响的加尔科特市和 Dhorpatan 市宣布为灾害危机区，为期三个月。对于受损私人住宅的受影响家庭，若不愿住在收容中心而自行安排临时住所，在替代住所安排到位前，最多六个月内按家庭人数发放临时救济：四人及以下家庭每月每户1.5万卢比，超过四人的家庭每增加一人每月加2000卢比。
items.summaryEn: NepalKhabar reported that a government meeting chaired by Prime Minister Balendra Shah decided to declare local levels severely affected by the Budhi Gandaki River flood as disaster crisis zones for three months, including Chumnubri, Dharche and Aarughat rural municipalities in Gorkha district and Wards 1 and 2 of Tripurasundari Rural Municipality in Dhading district. The meeting also decided to declare Galkot Municipality and Dhorpatan Municipality in Baglung district, severely affected by floods and landslides, as disaster crisis zones for three months. For affected families whose private homes were damaged and who prefer not to stay in holding centres but arrange temporary accommodation themselves, the decision provides interim relief for up to six months until alternative shelter is arranged: Rs 15,000 per household per month for families of up to four members and an additional Rs 2,000 per month per member beyond four.
items.analysis: 若该决定按来源所述执行，受影响家庭将获得明确的现金救济标准和三个月的危机区认定，这对重建阶段的消费能力和地方服务需求有直接影响；但救济金额与期限属于内阁决定，实际发放取决于地方执行和预算到位情况，来源未说明资金拨付机制。对客户而言，相关影响主要是灾区家庭购买力和地方行政资源转向救灾。下一步应核实：公报是否正式发布、救济金发放渠道（现金、银行转账或移动支付）以及是否涉及通信恢复专项安排。证据缺口包括决定的法律文本、受益人认定标准和执行时间表；来源未提及任何电信或数字政府措施。
items.analysisEn: If the decision is implemented as described, affected families would receive defined cash relief and a three-month crisis-zone designation, with direct implications for consumption capacity and local service demand during recovery; however, the amounts and duration are cabinet decisions, and actual disbursement depends on local execution and budget availability, which the source does not explain. For customers, the main impact is on disaster-affected households' purchasing power and on local administrative resources shifting to relief. Next verification steps: check whether an official gazette notice was published, identify the disbursement channel (cash, bank transfer or mobile payment) and establish whether any communications-restoration measures are included. Evidence gaps include the legal text of the decision, beneficiary criteria and an implementation timetable; the source mentions no telecom or digital-government measures.

items.title: 尼共（联合马列）退出马德西省政府，部长提交辞呈
items.titleEn: CPN-UML exits Madhesh provincial government, ministers submit resignations
items.status: DeepSeek 正文分析 · 待 Codex 核验
items.statusEn: DeepSeek article analysis · pending Codex review
items.summary: 据NepalKhabar报道，尼泊尔共产党（联合马列）退出马德西省政府，参加省政府的四名该党部长于周五辞职，该党同时撤回对首席部长克里希纳·普拉萨德·亚达夫领导的省政府的支持。向首席部长亚达夫递交辞呈的包括劳动与交通部长沙拉达·德维·塔帕、体育与社会福利部长拉坎达斯、物质基础设施发展部长穆罕默德·萨米尔以及教育与文化部长马诺杰·库马尔·辛格。该党部长还向省首苏伦德拉拉布·卡尔纳递交了撤回支持的函件。该党表示，撤回支持旨在推动组建新政府的努力。尼泊尔大会党领导人亚达夫领导的政府中还有尼泊尔共产党参与。
items.summaryEn: NepalKhabar reported that the CPN-UML exited the Madhesh provincial government, with its four ministers resigning on Friday, and that the party also withdrew its support for the provincial government led by Chief Minister Krishna Prasad Yadav. Those who submitted resignations to Chief Minister Yadav included Minister for Labour and Transport Sharada Devi Thapa, Minister for Sports and Social Welfare Lakhandas, Minister for Physical Infrastructure Development Mohammad Samir and Minister for Education and Culture Manoj Kumar Singh. The party's ministers also submitted a letter withdrawing support to Provincial Head Surendra Labh Karna. The party said it withdrew support with the aim of advancing efforts to form a new government. The government led by Nepali Congress leader Yadav also includes the Nepal Communist Party.
items.analysis: 若上述辞职和撤援属实，马德西省政府的稳定性将取决于能否及时组建新的多数，期间基础设施、交通等部门的日常决策可能放缓，这对依赖省级审批和道路协调的企业和居民有间接影响；但来源未说明任何电信或数字政策后果。对客户而言，潜在影响是省级政务服务与基建项目推进节奏的不确定性。下一步应核实：省首是否已接受辞呈、新政府组建的时间表，以及物质基础设施发展部的政策决定是否受影响。证据缺口包括辞呈是否正式生效、剩余执政联盟的席位构成，以及是否存在与通信或数字服务相关的省级政策变动；来源未提供这些信息。
items.analysisEn: If the resignations and withdrawal of support hold, the Madhesh provincial government's stability will depend on timely formation of a new majority, and day-to-day decisions in infrastructure, transport and other ministries could slow, with indirect effects on businesses and residents relying on provincial approvals and road coordination; the source states no telecom or digital policy consequence. For customers, the potential impact is uncertainty in the pace of provincial services and infrastructure projects. Next verification steps: confirm whether the provincial head accepted the resignations, the timetable for forming a new government and whether policy decisions by the Ministry of Physical Infrastructure Development are affected. Evidence gaps include whether the resignations took formal effect, the seat composition of the remaining coalition and whether any provincial policy changes concern communications or digital services; the source provides none of this.
